notes: The baseline is the 99 distinct columns in the checked-in BCO ORM, not an unverified copy of the deployed BCO physical table.
Existing HTH column capacities and data are preserved. New columns are nullable for both fresh and upgraded installations.
New VARCHAR2 capacities are explicit HTH definitions; available BCO assembler truncation widths are cited as such.
Financial and other out-of-scope fields retain BCO Java types but remain null; tokens and secrets are never collected.
